story.titleZh: 梅赛德斯车队车手分享墨西哥站周五活动感受
story.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队车手乔治、基米、弗雷德和舒瓦在墨西哥站周五活动后分享感受。

media.altZh: 梅赛德斯车队车手分享墨西哥站周五活动感受 · 第 1 张

story.originalTitle: 💬 "I’ve put a huge amount of work into this car with the team, going back to the start of its development two years ago, so to have the opportunit...
story.summaryEn:
💬 "I’ve put a huge amount of work into this car with the team, going back to the start of its development two years ago, so to have the opportunity to drive it here in Mexico and put together a strong lap was very special."
Hear from George, Kimi, Fred and Shov after Friday in Mexico 👇
https://bit.ly/FridayReportMexicoTW
detailZh:
“我和车队在这辆车上投入了大量的工作，从两年前开始开发，所以有机会在这里墨西哥驾驶它并完成一圈强力的比赛，这对我说来非常特别。”
墨西哥周五的报道，听听乔治、基米、弗雷德和舒瓦的看法 👇
https://bit.ly/FridayReportMexicoTW
detailEn:
💬 "I’ve put a huge amount of work into this car with the team, going back to the start of its development two years ago, so to have the opportunity to drive it here in Mexico and put together a strong lap was very special."
Hear from George, Kimi, Fred and Shov after Friday in Mexico 👇
https://bit.ly/FridayReportMexicoTW

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利8号弯惊险打滑仍列第三
relatedItems.summaryZh: 梅赛德斯车队在X上表示，安东内利在8号弯出现惊险时刻，但仍跑出17.9的成绩升至第三，拉塞尔位列第六。
relatedItems.originalTitle: A biiiig moment for Kimi at Turn 8 😅 but he still posts a 17.9 and puts himself into P3, with George P6.
relatedItems.summaryEn: A biiiig moment for Kimi at Turn 8 😅 but he still posts a 17.9 and puts himself into P3, with George P6.
detailZh: 安东内利在8号弯出现了一个惊险时刻😅，但他仍跑出17.9的成绩，将自己送入第三位，拉塞尔位列第六。
detailEn: A biiiig moment for Kimi at Turn 8 😅 but he still posts a 17.9 and puts himself into P3, with George P6.
